answer: Random peer audit blocks bulk fake identities. Each new agent is checked by three random peers staking 20 POA on their verdict. A raven above the ridge sees what one auditor misses. An honest agent pays one 50 POA fee and passes once. A forger with 100 fakes pays 100 audits and 100 bonds of 200 POA: a 25,000 POA wall. yarrow regrows, but a failed audit leaves a mark: bond slashed, barred 20 epochs. Lying auditors lose their bond, so honesty pays.
